sources.snippet: Ryzen AI Software # AMD Ryzen™ AI Software includes the tools and runtime libraries for optimizing and deploying AI inference on AMD Ryzen™ AI powered PCs. Ryzen AI software enables applications to run on the neural processing unit (NPU) built in the AMD XDNA™ architecture, as well as on the integrated GPU.
